claim_boundary: Retrospective diagnostic on the released official 22-case PhysTwin cohort. The cohort and its development/confirmation split have already informed BayesianPhysTwin development. Results may diagnose point accuracy, raw predictive calibration, horizon degradation, and selective risk, but must not be promoted as fresh independent validation, calibrated deployment uncertainty, or a new state-of-the-art claim.

model_average.components: the frozen 5 x 3 process/observation standard-deviation grid from the Bayesian anchor
model_average.uncertainty: within-component covariance plus between-component mean disagreement
